name: spp-commerce
label: SPP commerce rules
description: Companion plugin of the spp-customization theme: B2B account bar, cart and checkout rules, and the store API routes the theme cannot take over.

casePacks.label: Items sold in case packs: { "<SKU>": <pack size> } (quantities are rounded up to whole packs)

orderLimits.label: Per-order limits: { "<SKU>": <max quantity> } (a cart line over its limit is brought back to it)

minimums.label: Minimum order quantities: { "<SKU>": <min quantity> } (a cart line under its minimum is raised to it)

companions.label: Companion items: { "<SKU>": "<companion SKU>" } (added with the item, removed with it)

lineNotes.label: Show case-pack and order-limit notes under cart and checkout lines

cardTags.label: Show the ordering rules (case packs, minimums, limits) on product cards

pinnedSkus.label: Promoted SKUs, shown first in category and search listings (in this order)

freeShippingOver.label: Free shipping over this subtotal (0: no free-shipping meter)

salesReps.label: Sales reps by code: { "JR": "Jordan Rivera" } (their links: /api/extensions/plugins/spp-commerce/rep?code=JR&to=/)

showAccountBar.label: Show the account bar above the header

erpWebhookSecret.label: Shared secret the ERP signs its stock webhooks with (X-Erp-Signature: sha256=<HMAC of the body>); empty: the webhook takes nothing
